jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) CLEAN BLOSSOM LIQUID SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Dispenser bottle.

Clean Blossom | A luminous bouquet enhanced by a sophisticated woody signature. A cheerful scent where three precious white flowers celebrate their faceted beauty. An enveloping heart of jasmine glows with the vibrant citrus tones of orange blossom and the sensual exoticism of vanilla flower.

Notes:
Top notes: petit grain, tangerine, pine cone, bergamot.
Heart notes: orange blossom, spicy lavender, jasmine, vanilla flower.
Base notes: vanilla, tonka bean, vetiver, ambrox.
